helpers.note: Optional third-party helper websites named in docs/writing.md (Helpers for common tasks). Each URL loaded on the review date. Re-check links, menu names, and privacy notes yearly; name no other tool on student pages without a recorded re-review.

tools.name: Tables Generator
tools.task: tables from spreadsheet cells, CSV, or Excel
tools.verified: Page loads; File > Import CSV or Excel file and paste from a spreadsheet; booktabs style; column width gives p{} columns; Escape special characters option (its help text says special characters are escaped); packages named in a comment. Changelog version 26.10.1. Privacy policy: table contents are sent to its server for some features and not stored permanently; CSV import is client-side (changelog 24.05.2). The guide's matching hand-written snippets compile with the class (the tool's own output was not compiled): p{5cm}, \multicolumn, \cmidrule, escaped & % _ # $.

tools.name: LaTeXEditor.app
tools.task: equations by clicking symbols, fractions, matrices, systems, chemistry
tools.verified: Page loads without sign-in; source shown in a text box without delimiters; System of equations inserts aligned, which compiles inside equation with one number. Preview is KaTeX-like and lists amsmath, amssymb, amsfonts, mathtools, cancel, mhchem, so it accepts commands the thesis may not load. With the class: \usepackage[version=4]{mhchem} compiles; a pasted \usepackage{amssymb} or {amsfonts} is harmless, because the class marks both as loaded (before that fix they conflicted with newtxmath: Command \Bbbk already defined). The Copy button was not confirmed to copy the source; the guide says to copy from the text box.

tools.name: Detexify
tools.task: find the command for one hand-drawn symbol
tools.verified: Page loads; project https://github.com/kirel/detexify-next says classification runs in the browser (Web Worker). \nabla, \mathbb, \varnothing, \leqslant compile with the class without amssymb.

tools.name: draw.io
tools.task: flowcharts, block and process diagrams, schematics
tools.verified: Page loads. Per https://www.drawio.com/docs/manual/export/export-to-pdf/ : File > Export As > PDF has a Crop option and sends the diagram to the draw.io server (deleted after the PDF is returned); File > Print keeps it local. Print with Crop sets the page size to the drawing (read from the app's print code; not supported in Safari); not tested by hand. A PDF next to its .drawio source compiles with \includegraphics{figures/my-diagram}.

tools.name: Mathcha
tools.verified: Home page loads; editor at https://www.mathcha.io/editor. TikZ export unverified with this class; verify before expanding. \usepackage{tikz} itself compiles with the class.

tools.name: Lagrida LaTeX Equation Editor
tools.verified: Evaluated; basic editing works without sign-in; omitted to avoid two similar editors (no distinct advantage over LaTeXEditor.app found).

legacy_reference: RPI's official LaTeX template (thesis.cls and samples), available from RPI ITS's Thesis Preparation page, is the formatting baseline; differences are listed in requirements.md. Not redistributed: maintainers keep a reference copy in _local/legacy/ (ignored by Git).

conversion_tools.note: Tools named in docs/bring-your-draft.md (From Markdown). Re-check yearly and whenever Pandoc changes its LaTeX output.

tools.name: Pandoc
tools.task: optional first pass of a long Markdown chapter into chapter content
tools.verified: Pandoc 3.11, command: pandoc my-chapter.md --to=latex --biblatex --top-level-division=chapter --output=my-chapter.tex. Output is a fragment (no preamble) without --standalone. [@key] -> \autocite{key}, @key -> \textcite{key}; without --biblatex citations stay as text. # -> \chapter, ## -> \section (default: # -> \section). $$...$$ -> \[ \] (unnumbered). Pipe table -> longtable with \noalign{} and \endhead; caption only from a ': Caption' line; class does not load longtable, so compile fails (Environment longtable undefined); it compiles when \usepackage{longtable} is uncommented in preamble.tex. Image -> \pandocbounded{\includegraphics[keepaspectratio,alt={...}]{...}} in figure without placement; \pandocbounded undefined. {#fig:x} -> \label{fig:x}. Tight lists emit \tightlist (undefined); loose lists do not. Raw \ref passes through; ~ becomes \textasciitilde{}. %, &, _, #, $ escaped. After the cleanup listed in the guide, a converted chapter compiled with latexmk -norc -pdf in a scratch copy of the starter: no errors, citation printed [1], equation, table, and figure numbered 4.1 and listed in the lists of tables and figures.

tools.name: PanWriter
tools.task: graphical Markdown editor that exports through Pandoc
tools.verified: Evaluated from official docs only (desktop app not installed or tested). Free, open-source editor for macOS, Windows, Linux; needs a separate Pandoc installation for File > Export (print-to-PDF from the preview does not use Pandoc). Export options come from the document's YAML output block and a default.yaml, which can add a preamble or standalone document; citations are not documented. Omitted because it adds a second tool and settings without removing the cleanup, and its .tex export is untested with this starter.
